title: S2-B3 continuous interaction scientific protocol freeze
decision: Freeze SW10_S2_B3_PROTOCOL_V1 prospectively for the eight certified continuous interactions. Test interaction coefficients at horizons 1,2,3,5,7,10 trading days using date-level cross-sectional coefficients and Newey-West HAC with Bartlett lag horizon-1. Apply joint Benjamini-Hochberg FDR q=0.05 across 48 interaction hypotheses; require |standardized effect| >= 0.20 plus frozen temporal, concentration, semantic and integrity gates for ADVANCE.
evidence: MWE-SW10-S2B3CP-001 COMPLETE/VERIFIED; 8/8 continuous interactions FEASIBLE; no B3 forward outcomes inspected in preflight.
rationale: The outcome-blind continuous preflight found all eight preregistered designs feasible under the frozen representation. Canonical thread authorized the scientific contract before B3 outcomes are generated.

metadata_json.model: date-level cross-sectional OLS: forward_return ~ intercept + primary_rank + conditioner_rank + interaction_product
prohibited: historical expected earnings dates treated as prospective
HAC lag changes based on results
metadata_json.advance_rule: BH q<=0.05 AND abs(ES)>=0.20 AND temporal sign coherence AND temporal concentration AND symbol concentration/sign robustness AND semantic/data-integrity gates
metadata_json.representation: same-date cross-sectional percentile rank with average ties mapped as 2*pct_rank-1; interaction=primary*conditioner
metadata_json.weak_evidence_rule: valid/testable and fails exactly one of FDR or material-effect primary gates while passing robustness/semantic gates
